summary: Scents Asia 2026 is a confirmed fragrance and wellness trade fair within Chiang Mai Design Week, with showcases, exhibitions, talks, awards and workshops at TCDC Chiang Mai. It is a short-run festival programme rather than a regular workshop venue; visitor admission and individual workshop details are not yet published.
whyGo: Explore Thai and Asian fragrance, local ingredients and scent-led design in one concentrated event.
The programme combines an exhibition and product showcase with talks and workshops, so it may suit visitors interested in creative industries as well as perfume.
bestFor: Design, fragrance, wellness and craft enthusiasts; visitors already planning to attend Chiang Mai Design Week.
skipIf: You need a guaranteed hands-on class, fixed session times, English-language instruction or a confirmed ticket price before planning.
duration: Allow 1–2 hours as a planning estimate for browsing; add time if a talk or workshop schedule that interests you is announced.
cost: Visitor admission and workshop prices are not stated in the current event listing. Do not assume the trade fair or workshops are free; confirm closer to the date.
hours: The Scents Asia listing gives 10:00–20:00 daily, 5–13 December 2026. These are event hours and may differ from TCDC's normal opening hours.
bestTime: Choose a weekday or arrive near opening for a quieter visit, as a planning suggestion; no crowd forecast or session timetable is published. Check the final programme before choosing a day.
gettingThere: At TCDC Chiang Mai, 1/1 Muang Samut Road, Chang Moi, behind Muang Mai Market. Use a taxi or local songthaew/tuk-tuk and provide the venue address; TCDC says parking is available beside the building. Public bus directions are not currently listed by TCDC.
booking: No visitor booking or ticket link is published. Workshop participation and any registration requirements are unconfirmed. The currently advertised form is a vendor open call, not a visitor ticket; contact Scents Asia through its linked social accounts for updates.
accessibility: The event listing does not describe step-free access, seating, scent sensitivities or other accommodations. Ask TCDC or the event organizers about access before visiting. Strong fragrance exposure may be uncomfortable for people with scent sensitivity.
practicalTips: Check the CMDW programme and Scents Asia social channels shortly before the trip for workshop times, language, visitor admission and any registration.
Allow flexibility: the event combines public-facing exhibitions with trade activity, and the visitor experience may vary by zone.
TCDC's general visitor page notes free parking beside its building; parking availability during the festival is not guaranteed.
decemberNotes: The official CMDW 2026 guide confirms Scents Asia at TCDC from 5–13 December 2026, 10:00–20:00. The page describes a festival trade fair, over 50 local brands, an immersive scent exhibition, awards, talks and workshops. The vendor application closes 25 October and selected vendors are due to be announced 30 October; those dates concern exhibitors, not visitor registration.
uncertainties: Visitor admission price, workshop fees, booking process, workshop timetable and language of delivery are not published.
Accessibility details and any scent-free or low-sensory provision are not stated.
The official event page does not explain whether all programme elements run throughout all nine days.
